thought.text: Production server is running and enforcing SSL as expected, so I'll stop the verification instance and do a final check.

reasoning_content:
Confirmed production environment is working: `RAILS_ENV=production bin/rails s` starts up and responds. It returns 301 → https (force_ssl: true as documented), and since there's no TLS certificate in the container, this is an expected environmental constraint. This matches the installer's report exactly.

Should I stop the production verification server to return to the previous state (or leave it running? The installer stopped their own temporary production server after verification. To keep the final state as the installer left it, I'll go ahead and stop it).

I'll also check whether the 301 response is an app-level force_ssl, and verify that the production environment booted without issues (no boot errors in the logs). After that, I'll kill it and delete the pid file I created (since it's a runtime file from my own verification, deleting it is cleanup of my own artifact, so no problem).

I'll also verify that the dev server is still running after all this.

action.command: grep -iE "error|exception|fatal" /tmp/prod_verify.log | head -5; echo "=== log status ==="; head -4 /tmp/prod_verify.log; echo "=== stop prod verify server ==="; kill $(cat /workspace/tmp/pids/prod_verify.pid) 2>/dev/null; sleep 3; rm -f /workspace/tmp/pids/prod_verify.pid; ps aux | grep "puma 5.6.8" | grep -v grep; echo "=== dev server still alive ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "dev /: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "grep -iE \"error|exception|fatal\" /tmp/prod_verify.log | head -5; echo \"=== log status ===\"; head -4 /tmp/prod_verify.log; echo \"=== stop prod verify server ===\"; kill $(cat /workspace/tmp/pids/prod_verify.pid) 2>/dev/null; sleep 3; rm -f /workspace/tmp/pids/prod_verify.pid; ps aux | grep \"puma 5.6.8\" | grep -v grep; echo \"=== dev server still alive ===\"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"dev /: %{http_code}\\n\" http://localhost:3000/", "summary": "Stop production verify server, confirm dev server"}

summary: Stop production verify server, confirm dev server
